description: Source code implementing auto-fitter hinting routines for Indic writing systems within the FreeType project, including metrics initialization, scaling, and hint application functions.

classes.name: AF_CJKMetricsRec
classes.description: Structure for CJK font metrics used in Indic hinting routines.

methods.name: af_indic_metrics_init
methods.description: Initializes font metrics for Indic scripts, setting units per em and checking digit metrics.

methods.name: af_indic_metrics_scale
methods.description: Scales font metrics for Indic scripts using CJK routines.

methods.name: af_indic_hints_init
methods.description: Initializes glyph hints for Indic scripts using CJK routines.

methods.name: af_indic_hints_apply
methods.description: Applies glyph hints to outlines for Indic scripts using CJK routines.
